name: dobe_drink_key
desc: keep the blue pillar and the little cat body exactly as they are. The pink goo doberman, seen from behind, pushes its head forward and to the right and presses its muzzle firmly onto the little cat face, its head completely covering the cat face so only the cat hat and body show, its body pressed close, thick pink goo overflowing and dribbling down from where its muzzle meets the cat face. Same pink colors, same rendering and pixel art style, the doberman lower body unchanged.
